19 - 11 = 8

questions.questionText: Rohan walks 12 km North, then turns right and walks 5 km. How far and in which direction is he from his starting point?

questions.questionText:
Statements:

2. Some flowers are red.
Conclusions:
I. Some roses are red.

options.text: Either Conclusion I or II follows
Neither Conclusion I nor II follows

P is to the immediate left of T -> P, T
S is between T and Q -> P, T, S, Q
Q is to the immediate left of R -> P, T, S, Q, R
The middle person among the five (3rd position) is S.

R - Q means R is the wife of Q (so Q is the husband of R).
Since R is P's mother and Q is R's husband, Q is the father of P.

Anti-clockwise turn = -135 degrees from North-East -> North-East minus 45 is North, minus 90 is West.
Net change = +90 - 135 = -45 degrees (anti-clockwise) from North-West = West.
